verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a cloud hosting platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented capability to export all account or project data in open formats. The only migration evidence is inbound ("Migrate from Heroku"). Pulling variables via the MCP server is an adjacent feature, not a full data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
